selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What has the Qur'an kept doing for about 1,300 years?
questions.answer: It has kept shining with great honor through the years and across the earth.

questions.question: Why has the Qur'an continued in this strong and shining way?
questions.answer: Because of its special qualities and great features.

questions.question: What does one letter of the Qur'an earn at the least?
questions.answer: At least ten rewards.

questions.question: Besides rewards, what other good things does one letter bring?
questions.answer: Merits and lasting fruits.

questions.question: Do all letters always have only ten rewards, or can some have more?
questions.answer: Some can have much more.

questions.question: Which parts of the Qur'an are said to give a hundred or a thousand fruits, or even more?
questions.answer: Letters in some verses and surahs.

questions.question: What happens to the reward and light of each letter at blessed times?
questions.answer: It rises from ten to hundreds.

questions.question: Who understood this message in the passage?
questions.answer: The traveler through the world.

questions.question: After understanding this, who did the traveler speak to?
questions.answer: He spoke to his heart.

questions.question: How long does the passage say the Qur'an’s holy rule has lasted?
questions.answer: For one thousand three hundred years.

questions.question: What two places are described as being lit by the Qur'an?
questions.answer: The centuries and the earth.

questions.question: What kind of rule is the Qur'an said to have?
questions.answer: A holy and mighty rule.

questions.question: What makes this rule special?
questions.answer: It is lofty, full of light, and very splendid.

questions.question: What special honor does each letter of the Qur'an receive?
questions.answer: Each letter becomes a means for reward and blessing.

questions.question: What is the smallest number of rewards named for one letter?
questions.answer: Ten.

questions.question: At special times, does the value of each letter stay the same or grow?
questions.answer: It grows.

questions.question: What did the traveler learn before speaking to his heart?
questions.answer: He learned that the Qur'an has lasting greatness and brings many rewards.

questions.question: What did the traveler do after understanding these things?
questions.answer: He turned inward and spoke to his heart.

questions.question: What is one big reason the Qur'an is described as great in this passage?
questions.answer: It has many wonderful qualities.

questions.question: How is the Qur'an’s power described over time?
questions.answer: It keeps going with beauty and strength through many years.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the earth’s face?
questions.answer: The Qur'an has been lighting it.

questions.question: What is gained from each letter of the Qur'an?
questions.answer: Reward, merit, and eternal fruit.

questions.question: What does “eternal fruits” help us understand here?
questions.answer: The good results are not just for now; they last.

questions.question: Are only whole surahs valuable, or are letters valuable too?
questions.answer: Letters are valuable too.
